title: Particle-based Generalised Stochastic Optimisation
abstract: arXiv:2608.02844v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We develop a class of general diffusion-based stochastic particle optimisation methods for loss functions with intractable gradients. Specifically, we consider problems in which the loss gradient is an integral with respect to a parameter-dependent distribution, a structure that includes training generative models, fine-tuning, and learning latent-variable models. We introduce mean-field dynamics and its interacting-particle approximations, which contain several existing algorithms as special cases and provide a route to constructing new methods. Under well-posedness and joint contractivity assumptions, we prove exponential convergence and show that the continuous-time particle system admits a non-asymptotic error bound. We illustrate our framework by developing higher-order Langevin and momentum optimisers and evaluating them on maximum marginal-likelihood estimation and energy-based-model training.

translated_title: 基于粒子的广义随机优化
translated_abstract: 我们为具有难以求解梯度的损失函数开发了一类基于扩散的通用随机粒子优化方法。具体而言，我们考虑损失梯度是关于一个依赖于参数的分布的积分这一问题结构，该结构涵盖了训练生成模型、微调以及学习潜变量模型等场景。我们引入了平均场动力学及其交互粒子近似，其中包含多种现有算法作为特例，并为构建新方法提供了途径。在适定性与联合压缩性假设下，我们证明了指数收敛性，并表明连续时间粒子系统满足非渐近误差界。我们通过开发高阶Langevin和动量优化器，并在最大边际似然估计和基于能量的模型训练上进行评估，展示了该框架的应用。
tldr: 本文提出了针对不可解梯度损失函数的基于扩散的广义随机粒子优化框架，通过平均场动力学及其交互粒子近似统一了多种现有算法，证明了指数收敛性与非渐近误差界，并据此构建了高阶Langevin和动量优化器。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general framework of diffusion-based stochastic particle optimisation for loss functions with intractable gradients, unifying existing algorithms through mean-field dynamics and interacting-particle approximations with proven exponential convergence and non-asymptotic error bounds, from which higher-order Langevin and momentum optimisers are derived.
